Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1127
Claimant:
Jessica Thompson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2023-09-04
Claim opened after the insured reported being struck from behind while stopped at a traffic signal. The claimant, a
passenger in the insured vehicle, reported right shoulder pain at the scene and has since retained counsel, who
asked that all contact go through their office.
2023-09-07
The responding officer's report records a rear impact and notes the claimant seated in the rear of the insured vehicle.
Two independent witnesses at the intersection gave statements that match the accounts of the isnured and the other
driver.
2023-09-12
Scene photographs show damage to the rear bumper and tailgate of the insuerd vehicle, and the damage to the fornt
of the other vehicle lines up with it. The pattern and location fit the impact as reported.
2023-10-24
Coverage review complete. The driver is listed on the policy, the policy was in force at the time of loss, and nothing in
the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
2023-12-13
Claimant's counsel sent a medical summary describing a shoulder injury. The adjuster noted that the type of injury is
what would be expected from a rear impact of this force. The claimant's account given by phone matched what was
said at the scene.
2023-12-26
Prior records were requested from the claimant's providers and the insurer's database. No earlier treatment or
complaints involving the same shoulder are on file.
2023-12-29
Treatment followed a usual course, beginning with physiotherapy and anti-inflammatory medication. The treating
notes show steady improvement, with the number of sessions tapering as range of motion recovered.
2024-01-18
An inspection photograph from an earlier vheicle inspection shows a dent in the same rear panel area that appears to
match the damage now claimed. This conflicts with the other evidence and needs to be reconciled before the file
moves forward. The adjuster has asked the insured and the repair facility for an explanation.
2024-04-17
Claimant interviewed again with counsel present. The account was the same as in every prior conversation. The
earlier photograph was raised, and counsel said they would respond after speaking with the client.
2024-04-21
File referred for review of the prior-dent question. Reserve maintained pending counsel's response, and the next
follow-up is set for the coming week.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
